B: Milestone 3 Resubmission:
Milestone 3 was achieved despite challenges of having most students writing exams, handing in year assignments and doing practical IT software projects. The Coxygen Global smart contract learning support and coding takes place daily from 10:30 until 16:30 SAT timezones. Check videos dates, times and durations. Each video has unique date time stamp and #no for a different session. During these daily Cardano Smart Contract sessions: the live feedback is given, live guidance is given, coding on real applications like Rido donation app, market places took place. May of the activities repeat with new developers joining any part of the year. You will find some videos sessions repeated but they will be done with new attendees. In fact mile 3 and 4 have been achieved taking into considerations video lengths stretching up to 5 hours daily. Another challenge was that soon after end of year examinations students closed for holidays and remained with about 10 actively engaged in testing and helping with property smart contract development and testing. Concrete evidence is supplied below. Thank you.
